title: Resolve what the 3p21.31 endometriosis association establishes
question: Can disease and molecular associations distinguish HYAL3 regulation from linked signals, co-regulation and non-endometrial effects at 3p21.31?
scope: Source audit and gated regional analysis for inherited susceptibility. Use only public primary publications, aggregate supplements, public regional summary statistics and signed aggregate LD where permitted. Exclude participant records, whole-genome analyses, lesion panels and issue 49.
steps: Read the four prior project reports and primary study methods.
Audit regional GWAS, credible sets, secondary signals and QTL measurement coverage.
Check availability of matching clinical GWAS, unselected QTL statistics and signed LD. Apply the dedicated design before any new regional estimates.
Report all attempted analyses, missing comparators and the most informative follow-up.
deliverables: Dedicated issue, branch, P0 queue entry and reviewable PR.
Source-linked locus report and dated release inventory under task-specific paths.
Offline check, tests and safe aggregate results where data permit.
acceptance: Document locus alleles, builds, ancestry, phenotype, fine-mapping assumptions and reuse where verified.
Distinguish signal sharing, correlated TWAS predictors and compartment identity.
Apply the frozen input gates and document blocked comparisons.
Give one scientific decision and a discriminating next experiment. Isolate all changes from issue 49.
